lessons.title: PROTECT THE GIFT
lessons.body: An overnight indicated double on a 1-lot is a gift. From this stamp forward, +50% on a 1-lot must REALIZE PROFIT or become a PROTECTED RUNNER with a published premium floor. +100% is a harvest or a tightened floor — not an unprotected hold into the cash open. This lesson is forward-only. It does not rewrite Trade Zero.

methodology.peakOpportunityPct: (highest verified executable bid after referenceEntry − referenceEntry) ÷ referenceEntry × 100
methodology.referenceEntry: First verifiable executable ASK after the timestamped public alert, inside preferred entry range, at or below maximum entry, before alert expiration/invalidation, with enough displayed size for the model position.
methodology.opportunityIdentifiedYes: Public card YES may be CHARTED (traded-price high ≥ +25% from reference entry) or VERIFIED EXECUTABLE. Official verified YES / verified +25% counts require a verifiable executable BID after a verified referenceEntry. Never collapse charted YES into verified YES.
rejectedPeakSources: overnight theoretical mark while options market closed
methodology.captureRate: managed realized profit ÷ maximum verified opportunity profit — only when Peak Opportunity is positive AND managed profit is positive AND both use verified executable data.
methodology.managedBalance: startingCash + unique-id managed P&L (including approved pre-rule baseline). Peak and all-or-nothing dollars never enter.
methodology.chartedPeakPct: (charted traded-price high after alert − reference entry) ÷ reference entry × 100. Not an executable bid. Excluded from official Peak aggregates.

visitorPeakStates.awaiting: AWAITING VERIFIED QUOTE DATA — only while the contract is still live AND capture is still possible (chain still quoted).
visitorPeakStates.notPreserved: NOT PRESERVED — insufficient historical quote evidence. The bid/NBBO was not captured before this 0DTE expired, so it cannot be verified later. Never use AWAITING after the chain is gone.

records: CHARTED PEAK — highest traded price after public alert/reference entry and before cutoff (Superchart 1m OHLC high, timestamped screenshot). Not executable.
VERIFIED EXECUTABLE PEAK — highest executable bid/NBBO/broker-verified price with preserved quote evidence (chain bid + size, timestamped). If the chain is gone, mark NOT PRESERVED. Never invent.
MANAGED RESULT — actual result from published management rules. Never the peak.
endOfSessionEvidence.note: These three never conflate. Missing bid evidence on an expired contract is a protocol miss, not a pending lookup.
